ex.en: I've just published a new post on my blog.
ex.zh: 我剛在部落格上發了一篇新文章。

ex.en: Her post got thousands of likes.
ex.zh: 她的貼文獲得數千個讚。

post.en: a message or picture that you put on the internet for others to see

ex.en: You need to stop posting private photos on Facebook.
ex.zh: 你不要再把私人照片貼到臉書上了。

ex.en: I posted a photo of my lunch on Instagram.
ex.zh: 我把午餐的照片貼到 IG 上。

post.en: to put a message or picture on the internet for others to see

ex.en: My grandmother posted the letter this morning.
ex.zh: 我奶奶今天早上寄出了那封信。

ex.en: Could you post this letter for me?
ex.zh: 可以幫我寄這封信嗎？

post.en: to send a letter or package by mail

ex.en: I don't think the post office is open yet.
ex.zh: 我想郵局應該還沒開。

ex.en: I need to go to the post office to send a package.
ex.zh: 我要去郵局寄包裹。

post.en: a place where you can buy stamps and send letters and packages

ex.en: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
ex.zh: 空氣污染會威脅我們的生存。

ex.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
ex.zh: 工廠廢棄物造成了嚴重的環境污染。

ex.en: Industrialization often goes hand in hand with pollution.
ex.zh: 工業化常常伴隨著污染。

pollution.en: dirty or harmful substances in the air, water, or land

ex.en: It isn't polite to stare at people.
ex.zh: 盯著人看是不禮貌的。

ex.en: It's not polite to point at others.
ex.zh: 用手指別人是不禮貌的。

ex.en: You should try to be more polite.
ex.zh: 你應該試著更有禮貌。

polite.en: showing good manners and respect for other people

ex.en: His music has attained great popularity overseas.
ex.zh: 他的音樂在國外很受歡迎。

ex.en: The movie gained her great popularity.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓她大受歡迎。

ex.en: His first work gained great popularity among people.
ex.zh: 他的第一部作品深受大眾喜愛。

popularity.en: the state of being liked or enjoyed by many people

ex.en: He paused to look at the poster.
ex.zh: 他停下腳步看海報。

ex.en: Where are those posters now?
ex.zh: 那些海報現在都到哪裡去了？

ex.en: We put up posters for the event.
ex.zh: 我們為這場活動張貼了海報。

poster.en: a large printed picture or notice put on a wall

ex.en: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.
ex.zh: 我有個朋友要我寄一張明信片給她。

ex.en: How much does it cost to send a postcard to Australia?
ex.zh: 寄一張明信片到澳洲要多少錢？

ex.en: Put this stamp on the postcard and drop it in the mailbox.
ex.zh: 把這張郵票貼在明信片上，然後投進郵筒。

postcard.en: a card with a picture on one side that you send by mail without an envelope

ex.en: I got him to polish my shoes.
ex.zh: 我請他幫我擦皮鞋。

ex.en: Susan polished her father's shoes.
ex.zh: 蘇珊把她爸爸的鞋擦亮了。

ex.en: We polished our shoes.
ex.zh: 我們把鞋子擦亮了。

polish.en: to rub something to make it shine

ex.en: I need to polish my presentation before Friday.
ex.zh: 我得在星期五前把簡報再修飾一下。

ex.en: She took a course to polish her English.
ex.zh: 她上了一門課來加強英文。

polish.en: to make something better by making small changes

ex.en: She bought a new bottle of nail polish.
ex.zh: 她買了一瓶新的指甲油。

ex.en: Apply a little furniture polish with a soft cloth.
ex.zh: 用軟布塗一點家具亮光劑。

polish.en: a liquid or cream used to make a surface shine or to colour nails

ex.en: How much is the postage for this letter?
ex.zh: 這封信的郵資是多少？

ex.en: Postage is included in the price.
ex.zh: 價格已包含郵資。

postage.en: the money you pay to send a letter or package by mail

ex.en: The device is portable.
ex.zh: 這台裝置是可攜式的。

ex.en: I bought a portable charger for my phone.
ex.zh: 我買了一個手機用的行動電源。

ex.en: This portable speaker is very light.
ex.zh: 這台攜帶式喇叭很輕。

portable.en: small and light enough to be carried or moved easily

ex.en: Please include your postal code.
ex.zh: 請附上你的郵遞區號。

ex.en: Postal rates will go up next year.
ex.zh: 郵資明年會調漲。

postal.en: relating to the sending of letters and packages by mail

ex.en: To reach the North Pole is not easy.
ex.zh: 要到達北極可不容易。

ex.en: Santa lives at the North Pole.
ex.zh: 聖誕老人住在北極。

pole.en: one of the two points at the very top and bottom of the Earth

ex.en: The flag hung from a tall pole.
ex.zh: 旗子掛在一根高高的旗竿上。

ex.en: A car crashed into a telephone pole.
ex.zh: 一輛車撞上了電線桿。

pole.en: a long thin round piece of wood or metal

ex.en: I bought two bags of popcorn.
ex.zh: 我買了兩袋爆米花。

ex.en: Popcorn is my favorite snack.
ex.zh: 爆米花是我最喜歡的零食。

ex.en: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
ex.zh: 把融化的奶油淋在爆米花上。

popcorn.en: a snack made of corn that puffs up when heated

ex.en: I'm interested in oriental pottery.
ex.zh: 我對東方陶藝很有興趣。

ex.en: She takes a pottery class on weekends.
ex.zh: 她週末去上陶藝課。

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of ancient pottery.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了許多精美的古代陶器。

pottery.en: pots, dishes, and other objects made from baked clay, or the art of making them

ex.en: Thanks to a cold summer, beer has sold poorly.
ex.zh: 由於夏天很涼，啤酒賣得不好。

ex.en: The lubrication system was poorly designed.
ex.zh: 潤滑系統設計不良。

ex.en: The meeting was poorly organized.
ex.zh: 這場會議籌辦得很差。

poorly.en: in a bad way or at a low standard

ex.en: I've been feeling poorly for the last couple of days.
ex.zh: 我這兩天覺得身體不太舒服。

ex.en: My grandmother has been poorly since last week.
ex.zh: 我奶奶從上週開始身體就不太舒服。

ex.en: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡力不汙染環境。

ex.en: The air was polluted by exhaust gas.
ex.zh: 空氣被廢氣汙染了。

ex.en: Sewage often pollutes the ocean.
ex.zh: 汙水經常汙染海洋。

pollute.en: to make air, water, or land dirty and harmful

ex.en: The issue is politically sensitive.
ex.zh: 這個議題在政治上很敏感。

ex.en: It's important to be politically correct at work.
ex.zh: 在職場上說話要注意政治正確。

politically.en: in a way that relates to government and the way a country is run

ex.en: He is often described as a populist.
ex.zh: 他常被形容為民粹主義者。

ex.en: The populist won strong support from rural voters.
ex.zh: 那位民粹主義者獲得鄉村選民的強力支持。

populist.en: a politician who claims to represent ordinary people against powerful groups

ex.en: Populist policies are popular but often costly.
ex.zh: 民粹政策很受歡迎，但往往代價高昂。

ex.en: The party took a populist approach to taxes.
ex.zh: 這個政黨在稅務上採取民粹路線。

populist.en: aimed at winning the support of ordinary people against powerful groups

ex.en: If you don't know the way, ask a policeman.
ex.zh: 如果你不知道路，就去問警察。

ex.en: He wants to be a policeman in the future.
ex.zh: 他將來想當警察。

ex.en: New York City policemen wear dark blue uniforms.
ex.zh: 紐約的警察穿深藍色制服。

policeman.en: a man who works for the police

ex.en: Customers responded positively to the new design.
ex.zh: 顧客對新設計反應很正面。

ex.en: Try to think positively about the change.
ex.zh: 試著用正面的態度看待這次改變。

positively.en: in a good or hopeful way

ex.en: The food was positively delicious.
ex.zh: 這些食物簡直太好吃了。

ex.en: The service there was positively awful.
ex.zh: 那裡的服務真的糟透了。

positively.en: used to stress that something is really true

ex.en: This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
ex.zh: 這種毒藥用來除蟑螂很有效。

ex.en: His laboratory contains all the deadliest poisons.
ex.zh: 他的實驗室裡有各種最致命的毒物。

poison.en: a substance that can make people or animals very ill or kill them

ex.en: Waste from the factory poisoned the river.
ex.zh: 工廠的廢棄物汙染了那條河。

ex.en: Many people were poisoned by the bad seafood.
ex.zh: 許多人吃了不新鮮的海鮮而食物中毒。

poison.en: to harm or kill someone with a dangerous substance, or to make something dirty and harmful

ex.en: The movie portrays life in a small town.
ex.zh: 這部電影描繪了小鎮生活。

ex.en: The media often portrays him as a hero.
ex.zh: 媒體常把他描述成英雄。

portray.en: to show or describe someone or something in a picture, film, or writing

ex.en: She portrayed a young doctor in the film.
ex.zh: 她在片中飾演一位年輕醫生。

ex.en: He is famous for portraying historical figures.
ex.zh: 他以飾演歷史人物聞名。

portray.en: to act the part of a character in a film or play

ex.en: Policymakers are worried about rising prices.
ex.zh: 政策制定者擔心物價上漲。

ex.en: The report was written for policymakers.
ex.zh: 這份報告是寫給決策者看的。

policymaker.en: a person who helps decide the plans and rules of a government or organization

ex.en: Policyholders can file claims online.
ex.zh: 保戶可以在線上申請理賠。

ex.en: The insurer sent a letter to all policyholders.
ex.zh: 保險公司寄了一封信給所有保戶。

policyholder.en: a person who has bought an insurance agreement

ex.en: I can't go along with you on that point.
ex.zh: 在那一點上，我無法同意你。

ex.en: That's a good point.
ex.zh: 你說得很有道理。

point.en: an idea or fact that is said or written in a discussion

ex.en: To pass, you need to score over 60 points.
ex.zh: 你要考六十分以上才能及格。

ex.en: Our team won by three points.
ex.zh: 我們隊贏了三分。

point.en: a unit used to count the score in a game or test

ex.en: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
ex.zh: 他指出了守法的重要性。

ex.en: The teacher pointed out your mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師指出了你的錯誤。

point.en: to tell someone about a fact or make them notice it

ex.en: There is no point in pretending to be sick.
ex.zh: 裝病沒有用。

ex.en: There's no point in waiting any longer.
ex.zh: 再等下去也沒有意義。

point.en: used to say that something is useless

ex.en: It's rude to point at people.
ex.zh: 用手指著別人很沒禮貌。

ex.en: She pointed to the map.
ex.zh: 她指著地圖。

point.en: to show where something is by holding out a finger or object

ex.en: It's not possible to study with so much noise!
ex.zh: 這麼吵根本不可能讀書！

ex.en: It's not possible to do two things at once.
ex.zh: 不可能同時做兩件事。

ex.en: Is it possible to change my seat?
ex.zh: 可以換座位嗎？

possible.en: able to happen or be done

ex.en: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.
ex.zh: 可能的話，我想環遊世界。

ex.en: If possible, I would like to go home now.
ex.zh: 可以的話，我現在想回家。

possible.en: used to say that you want something only if it can be done

ex.en: I need to complete it as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 我需要盡快完成這件事。

ex.en: Please reply as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 請盡快回覆。

possible.en: as quickly as it can be done

ex.en: Is the power cord plugged into a power outlet?
ex.zh: 電源線插到插座了嗎？

ex.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: 核電廠很危險，更別說核武了。

ex.en: The power went out during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間停電了。

power.en: energy, especially electricity, used to make machines work

ex.en: The manager has the power to approve the budget.
ex.zh: 經理有權核准預算。

ex.en: Knowledge is power.
ex.zh: 知識就是力量。

power.en: the ability or right to control people or events

ex.en: The car is powered by electricity.
ex.zh: 這輛車是用電驅動的。

ex.en: Solar panels power the whole building.
ex.zh: 太陽能板供應整棟大樓的電力。

power.en: to give a machine the energy it needs to work

ex.en: The organization is not connected with any political parties.
ex.zh: 這個組織跟任何政黨都沒有關聯。

ex.en: We do not belong to a political organisation.
ex.zh: 我們不屬於任何政治組織。

ex.en: Money counts for much in political circles.
ex.zh: 在政界，金錢非常重要。

political.en: relating to government and the way a country is run

ex.en: The rich are not always happier than the poor.
ex.zh: 有錢人不一定比窮人幸福。

ex.en: Mali is one of the poorest countries in Subsaharan Africa.
ex.zh: 馬利是撒哈拉以南非洲最貧窮的國家之一。

ex.en: The aim of this policy is to improve the environment in the poorest cities.
ex.zh: 這項政策的目標是改善最貧困城市的環境。

ex.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
ex.zh: 那個可憐的孩子快餓死了。

ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
ex.zh: 這個可憐的年輕人後來成為了偉大的藝術家。

poor.en: deserving sympathy because of bad luck

ex.en: The product failed because of poor quality.
ex.zh: 這項產品因品質不佳而失敗。

ex.en: I'm poor at math.
ex.zh: 我數學很差。

poor.en: of a low standard or quality

ex.en: I don't understand why pepperoni pizza is so popular.
ex.zh: 我不懂為什麼義式臘腸披薩這麼受歡迎。

ex.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
ex.zh: 大富翁是很受歡迎的家庭遊戲。

ex.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
ex.zh: 聽說高爾夫在日本很流行。

popular.en: liked or enjoyed by many people

ex.en: She is full of potential.
ex.zh: 她充滿潛力。

ex.en: He has enormous potential.
ex.zh: 他有極大的潛力。

ex.en: Do you have leadership potential?
ex.zh: 你有領導潛力嗎？

potential.en: the ability to develop or become better in the future

ex.en: We are meeting a potential client tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天要見一位潛在客戶。

ex.en: We discussed the potential risks of the plan.
ex.zh: 我們討論了這個計畫的潛在風險。

potential.en: possible in the future but not yet real

ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
ex.zh: 試著對每件事都抱持積極的態度。

ex.en: Positive thinking is a way of living.
ex.zh: 正面思考是一種生活方式。

ex.en: The feedback from customers has been very positive.
ex.zh: 客戶的回饋非常正面。

positive.en: hopeful and thinking about good things

ex.en: I am positive that he is wrong.
ex.zh: 我確定他錯了。

ex.en: I am positive that he has finished.
ex.zh: 我確定他已經完成了。

ex.en: Tom tested positive for the flu.
ex.zh: 湯姆的流感檢驗呈陽性。

ex.en: Two employees tested positive this week.
ex.zh: 本週有兩名員工檢測呈陽性。

positive.en: showing that a disease or substance is present in a medical test

ex.en: There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
ex.zh: 你有可能得那樣做。

ex.en: There is not much possibility of his coming on time.
ex.zh: 他準時到的可能性不大。

ex.en: Don't look down on yourself, because people have limitless possibilities.
ex.zh: 不要小看自己，因為人有無限的可能。

possibility.en: the chance that something may happen or be true

ex.en: The price of the picture is 10 pounds.
ex.zh: 這幅畫要價十英鎊。

ex.en: The ticket costs twenty pounds.
ex.zh: 這張票要二十英鎊。

pound.en: the unit of money used in the United Kingdom

ex.en: This bag weighs about ten pounds.
ex.zh: 這個袋子大約重十磅。

ex.en: I lost five pounds last month.
ex.zh: 我上個月瘦了五磅。

pound.en: a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams

ex.en: The manager reprimanded the man by pounding on the table.
ex.zh: 經理用力捶桌子斥責那名男子。

ex.en: Someone was pounding on the door.
ex.zh: 有人在用力敲門。

pound.en: to hit something hard many times

ex.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
ex.zh: 很多日本人對政治漠不關心。

ex.en: You'd better avoid discussion of religion and politics.
ex.zh: 你最好避免談論宗教和政治。

ex.en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
ex.zh: 我們國家的年輕人對政治不感興趣。

politics.en: the work and ideas of governing a country or area

politics.zh: （組織內的）權力鬥爭、人際角力

ex.en: I try to stay out of office politics.
ex.zh: 我盡量不捲入辦公室政治。

ex.en: Office politics made her quit her job.
ex.zh: 辦公室的權力鬥爭讓她辭職了。

politics.en: the way people in a group compete for power and advantage

pop.zh: 流行的、通俗的（尤指流行音樂）

ex.en: I'd like to listen to pop music.
ex.zh: 我想聽流行音樂。

ex.en: Young people all like pop music.
ex.zh: 年輕人都喜歡流行音樂。

pop.en: relating to modern music that is liked by many people

pop.zh: pop up / pop out：突然出現；（短暫）出去一下

ex.en: Tom's just popped out to get some milk.
ex.zh: 湯姆剛出去買牛奶。

ex.en: A message popped up on my screen.
ex.zh: 我的螢幕上突然跳出一則訊息。

pop.en: to appear suddenly, or to go out for a short time

ex.en: Love is more powerful than death.
ex.zh: 愛比死亡更強大。

ex.en: He has powerful arms.
ex.zh: 他的手臂很有力。

ex.en: This laptop has a powerful processor.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有強大的處理器。

ex.en: She is one of the most powerful women in business.
ex.zh: 她是商界最有權勢的女性之一。

ex.en: The CEO is a very powerful person in the industry.
ex.zh: 那位執行長在業界很有影響力。

powerful.en: having great control or influence over people

ex.en: You are allowed to use the hotel's swimming pool.
ex.zh: 你可以使用飯店的游泳池。

ex.en: The swimming pool is open to the public.
ex.zh: 這座游泳池開放給民眾使用。

ex.en: While swimming in the pool, she lost her locker key.
ex.zh: 她在游泳池游泳時弄丟了置物櫃鑰匙。

pool.en: a place filled with water for people to swim in

ex.en: Let's pool our money and buy her a gift.
ex.zh: 我們湊錢買份禮物給她吧。

ex.en: The two teams pooled their resources.
ex.zh: 兩個團隊整合了彼此的資源。

pool.en: to put money or things together so that a group can use them

ex.en: The company has a large pool of talent.
ex.zh: 這家公司有龐大的人才庫。

ex.en: There is only a small pool of qualified candidates.
ex.zh: 符合資格的人選不多。

pool.en: a supply of people or things that can be used when needed

ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
ex.zh: 工廠下週可能會關閉。

ex.en: My father will possibly come on the next train.
ex.zh: 我父親可能會搭下一班火車來。

possibly.en: used to say that something may be true or may happen

ex.en: It can't possibly be true.
ex.zh: 這不可能是真的。

ex.en: I could not possibly finish the work in a few days.
ex.zh: 我不可能在幾天內做完這些工作。

ex.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
ex.zh: 能不能請你提出一個解決問題的辦法？

possibly.en: used to stress what is or is not able to happen, or to make a request polite

ex.en: A recent poll shows that most people support the plan.
ex.zh: 最近的民調顯示大多數人支持這項計畫。

ex.en: We conducted an online poll of our customers.
ex.zh: 我們對顧客做了一項線上調查。

poll.en: a survey that asks people what they think about something

ex.en: Voters will go to the polls next Saturday.
ex.zh: 選民將在下週六投票。

ex.en: The polls close at 8 p.m.
ex.zh: 投票所晚上八點關閉。

poll.en: an election, or the place where people vote

ex.en: We polled 500 employees about their working hours.
ex.zh: 我們針對工時調查了 500 名員工。

ex.en: Most of the people polled were satisfied.
ex.zh: 大多數受訪者表示滿意。

poll.en: to ask a group of people their opinions about something

ex.en: The politician didn't appear in public after the incident.
ex.zh: 那件事之後，那位政治人物就沒有再公開露面。

ex.en: Politicians are good at raising money.
ex.zh: 政客都很會募款。

ex.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
ex.zh: 對政治人物來說，口誤有時是致命的。

politician.en: a person whose job is in politics, especially an elected one

ex.en: I don't have any money in my pockets.
ex.zh: 我口袋裡沒錢。

ex.en: John took a key out of his pocket.
ex.zh: 約翰從口袋裡拿出一把鑰匙。

ex.en: He put his hands in his pockets.
ex.zh: 他把手插進口袋裡。

pocket.en: a small bag sewn into clothes for carrying small things

ex.en: I always carry a pocket dictionary.
ex.zh: 我總是隨身帶著一本袖珍字典。

ex.en: This pocket guide is perfect for travelers.
ex.zh: 這本口袋指南非常適合旅客。

pocket.en: small enough to be carried in your clothes

ex.en: He pocketed the change and left.
ex.zh: 他把找的零錢放進口袋就走了。

ex.en: The manager was accused of pocketing company money.
ex.zh: 那名經理被指控私吞公款。

pocket.en: to put something in a small bag sewn in clothes, or to take money that is not yours

ex.en: Kaohsiung is the largest port city in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 高雄是台灣最大的港口城市。

ex.en: The fishing boat which had been missing returned safely to port.
ex.zh: 失蹤的漁船平安返港了。

port.en: a town or place where ships stop to load and unload

ex.en: Plug the cable into the USB port.
ex.zh: 把線插進 USB 連接埠。

ex.en: My laptop only has two USB ports.
ex.zh: 我的筆電只有兩個 USB 連接埠。

port.en: a socket on a computer where you connect another device

port.zh: 移植（軟體、遊戲到其他平台）

ex.en: The game hasn't been ported to PC.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲還沒有移植到電腦上。

ex.en: The app was ported to Android last year.
ex.zh: 這個 App 去年移植到了 Android 平台。

port.en: to change a program so that it works on a different system

ex.en: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
ex.zh: 把融化的奶油淋在爆米花上。

ex.en: Tom poured cold water over himself to wake himself up.
ex.zh: 湯姆往自己身上澆冷水來提神。

ex.en: Can you pour me a glass of water?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我倒杯水嗎？

pour.en: to make liquid flow out of a container

ex.en: It's been pouring here for the last few days.
ex.zh: 這裡最近幾天一直在下大雨。

ex.en: It's pouring outside, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 外面在下大雨，帶把傘吧。

ex.en: Refugees poured in from all over the country.
ex.zh: 難民從全國各地湧入。

ex.en: Orders poured in after the ad campaign.
ex.zh: 廣告活動後訂單大量湧入。

pour.en: to arrive or move somewhere in large numbers

ex.en: Smoking poses a serious risk to your health.
ex.zh: 吸菸對健康構成嚴重威脅。

ex.en: The new rules may pose a problem for small businesses.
ex.zh: 新規定可能會對小型企業造成問題。

pose.en: to be or cause a problem or danger

ex.en: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
ex.zh: 當你提出問題，就會期待得到答案。

ex.en: She posed an interesting question during the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議中提出了一個有趣的問題。

pose.en: to ask a question or bring up a matter

ex.en: The team posed for a photo after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，隊員們擺姿勢合照。

ex.en: We posed in front of the tower for a picture.
ex.zh: 我們在塔前擺姿勢拍照。

pose.en: to stay in a certain position so that someone can take your picture

ex.en: She taught me how to write a poem.
ex.zh: 她教我怎麼寫詩。

ex.en: His daughter is able to recite a lot of poems.
ex.zh: 他的女兒能背很多首詩。

ex.en: Have you ever read any Chinese poems?
ex.zh: 你讀過中國詩嗎？

poem.en: a piece of writing in short lines that often rhyme and express feelings

ex.en: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
ex.zh: 一部分收益將用於幫助身心障礙兒童。

ex.en: A large portion of the budget goes to marketing.
ex.zh: 預算中有很大一部分用在行銷上。

portion.en: a part of a larger whole

ex.en: He finished the steak, then ordered another portion.
ex.zh: 他吃完牛排，又點了一份。

ex.en: The portions are ginormous.
ex.zh: 這裡的份量超大。

portion.en: the amount of food served to one person

ex.en: How did he make his living in such poverty?
ex.zh: 他在這麼貧困的情況下要怎麼維生？

ex.en: The president called on the people to unite in fighting poverty and disease.
ex.zh: 總統呼籲人民團結對抗貧窮與疾病。

ex.en: There is nowhere in the whole world without poverty.
ex.zh: 全世界沒有一個地方沒有貧窮。

poverty.en: the state of having very little money

ex.en: My uncle is possessed of great wealth.
ex.zh: 我叔叔擁有大量財富。

ex.en: She possesses excellent communication skills.
ex.zh: 她具備出色的溝通能力。

ex.en: Do you possess a valid driver's license?
ex.zh: 你有有效的駕照嗎？

possess.en: to own something or have a quality

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村莊。

ex.en: He is not a poet but a novelist.
ex.zh: 他不是詩人，而是小說家。

ex.en: Many famous philosophers and poets come from Athens.
ex.zh: 很多有名的哲學家和詩人都來自雅典。

ex.en: It's been quite a while since I've written poetry.
ex.zh: 我已經好久沒寫詩了。

ex.en: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
ex.zh: 他們稱喬叟為英詩之父。

ex.en: He prefers poetry to fiction.
ex.zh: 比起小說，他更喜歡詩。

poetry.en: poems as a form of writing

ex.en: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
ex.zh: 這顆球是那個男孩最珍惜的寶貝。

ex.en: He lost all his possessions in the fire.
ex.zh: 他在火災中失去了所有財物。

ex.en: The Spanish team is great at keeping possession of the ball.
ex.zh: 西班牙隊很擅長控球。

ex.en: The documents are now in our possession.
ex.zh: 那些文件現在在我們手上。

possession.en: the state of having or holding something

ex.en: Because Tom didn't thoroughly clean the pots, Mary got dysentery.
ex.zh: 因為湯姆沒有把鍋子洗乾淨，瑪麗得了痢疾。

ex.en: Boil some water in a large pot.
ex.zh: 用大鍋子煮一些水。

pot.en: a deep round container used for cooking

ex.en: Do you offer coffee pots in different sizes?
ex.zh: 你們有不同尺寸的咖啡壺嗎？

ex.en: There is no sugar left in the pot.
ex.zh: 罐子裡沒有糖了。

ex.en: I'll make a pot of tea for everyone.
ex.zh: 我來幫大家泡一壺茶。

pot.en: a container used for making or keeping a hot drink or other things

ex.en: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
ex.zh: 她把花盆裡的土換新了。

ex.en: She planted some herbs in a small pot.
ex.zh: 她在小花盆裡種了一些香草。

pot.en: a container with soil for growing plants

ex.en: This mistake could potentially cost us millions.
ex.zh: 這個錯誤可能讓我們損失數百萬。

ex.en: The new market is potentially very profitable.
ex.zh: 這個新市場可能非常有利可圖。

ex.en: Smoking is potentially harmful to the people around you.
ex.zh: 吸菸可能危害你身邊的人。

potentially.en: in a way that may happen in the future

ex.en: I am peeling the celery and the potatoes.
ex.zh: 我在削芹菜和馬鈴薯。

ex.en: I want to slice these potatoes into strips.
ex.zh: 我想把這些馬鈴薯切成絲。

ex.en: Potatoes are one of the most common foodstuffs.
ex.zh: 馬鈴薯是最常見的食材之一。

potato.en: a round vegetable with brown skin that grows under the ground

ex.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
ex.zh: 我不該把一整包洋芋片吃完的。

ex.en: Potato chips are my favorite snack.
ex.zh: 洋芋片是我最愛的零食。

potato.en: a thin crisp slice of a fried root vegetable, eaten as a snack

ex.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上掛著鮑伯的肖像畫。

ex.en: The king’s portrait was unveiled to great applause.
ex.zh: 國王的肖像揭幕時，現場響起熱烈掌聲。

portrait.en: a painting or photograph of a person

ex.en: Please print the document in portrait orientation.
ex.zh: 請用直式列印這份文件。

ex.en: This photo looks better in portrait than landscape.
ex.zh: 這張照片直式比橫式好看。

portrait.en: a page layout that is taller than it is wide

ex.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
ex.zh: 極光是極地特有的現象。

ex.en: Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
ex.zh: 極地冰帽融化也可能導致海平面上升。

polar.en: relating to the area around the top or bottom of the Earth

ex.en: The two brothers have polar opposite personalities.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟的個性截然相反。

ex.en: Their views on the issue are polar opposites.
ex.zh: 他們對這個議題的看法完全相反。

ex.en: The film's portrayal of office life is very realistic.
ex.zh: 這部電影對上班族生活的描繪非常寫實。

ex.en: Critics praised her portrayal of the queen.
ex.zh: 影評稱讚她對女王一角的詮釋。

portrayal.en: a way of showing someone or something in a film, book, or picture

ex.en: She is taking a postgraduate course in finance.
ex.zh: 她正在念金融研究所課程。

ex.en: The university offers many postgraduate programs.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供許多研究所課程。

postgraduate.en: relating to studies done after getting a first university degree

ex.en: Most of the postgraduates work as teaching assistants.
ex.zh: 大部分研究生都在當助教。

ex.en: As a postgraduate, he spends most of his time in the lab.
ex.zh: 身為研究生，他大部分時間都待在實驗室。

postgraduate.en: a student who is studying for a higher degree after a first university degree

ex.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.
ex.zh: 用本生燈加熱鉀，火焰會呈淡紫色。

ex.en: Bananas are a good source of potassium.
ex.zh: 香蕉是很好的鉀來源。

potassium.en: a soft silver-white metal element found in salts and used in fertilizer

ex.en: The table is covered with powder.
ex.zh: 桌上滿是粉末。

ex.en: Mix the powder with warm water.
ex.zh: 把粉末和溫水混合。

powder.en: a dry substance made of very small pieces like dust

ex.en: She powdered her face before going on stage.
ex.zh: 她上台前在臉上撲了粉。

ex.en: The baker powdered the cookies with sugar.
ex.zh: 麵包師傅在餅乾上撒了糖粉。

powder.en: to cover something with a fine dry dust

ex.en: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把黏土捏成一個碗。

ex.en: We bought some cups from a local potter.
ex.zh: 我們向一位當地陶藝家買了幾個杯子。

potter.en: a person who makes pots and dishes from clay

ex.en: The porter carried our luggage up to the room.
ex.zh: 行李員把我們的行李搬到房間。

ex.en: We tipped the porter at the train station.
ex.zh: 我們在火車站給了搬運工小費。

porter.en: a person whose job is to carry bags at a hotel or station

ex.en: The porter at the front desk signed for the package.
ex.zh: 櫃檯的門房幫忙簽收了包裹。

ex.en: Leave your keys with the porter when you go out.
ex.zh: 外出時把鑰匙交給門房。

porter.en: a person who guards the entrance of a building and helps visitors

ex.en: The children took turns riding the pony.
ex.zh: 孩子們輪流騎小馬。

ex.en: She got a pony for her tenth birthday.
ex.zh: 她十歲生日時得到一匹小馬。

ex.en: She tied her hair in a pony before the run.
ex.zh: 她跑步前把頭髮綁成馬尾。

ex.en: Amy usually wears her hair in a pony.
ex.zh: Amy 平常都綁馬尾。

pony.en: hair tied at the back of the head so that it hangs down

ex.en: I fully agree with your point of view.
ex.zh: 我完全贊成你的觀點。

ex.en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
ex.zh: 在我看來，汽車弊大於利。

ex.en: I understood Tom's point of view.
ex.zh: 我理解湯姆的觀點。

point of view.en: a particular way of thinking about something

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of Chinese porcelain.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了一批精美的中國瓷器。

ex.en: Be careful with the porcelain cup; it breaks easily.
ex.zh: 小心那只瓷杯，它很容易破。

porcelain.en: a hard white material used to make fine cups and dishes

ex.en: We learned how to factor a polynomial in math class.
ex.zh: 我們在數學課學了如何分解多項式。

ex.en: x² + 2x + 1 is a simple polynomial.
ex.zh: x² + 2x + 1 是個簡單的多項式。

polynomial.en: an expression in maths made of several terms added together

ex.en: Cars release harmful pollutants into the air.
ex.zh: 汽車把有害的汙染物排放到空氣中。

ex.en: The factory was fined for dumping pollutants into the river.
ex.zh: 那家工廠因為把汙染物排入河中而被罰款。

pollutant.en: a substance that makes air, water, or land dirty and harmful

ex.en: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.
ex.zh: 西里西亞省是波蘭人口稠密度最大的地區。

ex.en: The island is populated mainly by fishermen and their families.
ex.zh: 島上的居民主要是漁民和他們的家人。

ex.en: Taipei is one of the most densely populated cities in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 臺北是臺灣人口最稠密的城市之一。

populate.en: to live in a place, or to fill an area with people

ex.en: How large is the population of New York City?
ex.zh: 紐約市的人口有多少？

ex.en: The population has doubled in the last five years.
ex.zh: 過去五年人口增加了一倍。

ex.en: The population of the world will double before long.
ex.zh: 世界人口很快就會倍增。

population.en: the number of people who live in a place

ex.en: Only small populations of giraffes remain in this country.
ex.zh: 這個國家只剩下少數的長頸鹿族群。

ex.en: The tiger population is slowly increasing.
ex.zh: 老虎的數量正在慢慢增加。

population.en: the number of animals of one kind living in an area

ex.en: Our brand positioning focuses on quality, not low prices.
ex.zh: 我們的品牌定位著重品質，而非低價。

ex.en: The product failed because of poor positioning.
ex.zh: 這項產品因為定位不佳而失敗。

positioning.en: the way a company shows its product to be different from others in people's minds

ex.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
ex.zh: 這項政策導致物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.
ex.zh: 為了緩解就業壓力，國家已經制定了一系列相關政策。

ex.en: He had decided on a new policy.
ex.zh: 他已經決定了新的政策。

policy.en: a plan of action agreed on by a government or group

ex.en: Our return policy allows refunds within 30 days.
ex.zh: 我們的退貨規定是 30 天內可以退款。

ex.en: Company policy does not allow pets in the office.
ex.zh: 公司規定辦公室裡不能帶寵物。

policy.en: an official rule that a company uses

ex.en: Read your insurance policy carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀你的保單。

ex.en: The policy covers fire and theft.
ex.zh: 這份保單涵蓋火災和竊盜。

policy.en: a written agreement with an insurance company

ex.en: She added a short postscript to the letter.
ex.zh: 她在信末加了一段簡短附言。

ex.en: The postscript included the updated meeting time.
ex.zh: 附言裡補上了更新後的會議時間。

postscript.en: extra words added at the end of a letter after the signature

ex.en: The postmark shows that the letter was mailed yesterday.
ex.zh: 郵戳顯示這封信是昨天寄出的。

ex.en: Please check the postmark on the returned envelope.
ex.zh: 請查看退回信封上的郵戳。

postmark.en: an official mark on a letter showing the place and date it was sent

ex.en: The shipment cleared customs at its first port of entry.
ex.zh: 這批貨在第一個入境口岸完成通關。

ex.en: The form asks you to name the port of entry.
ex.zh: 表格要求填寫入境口岸。

port of entry.en: a place where people and goods officially enter a country

ex.en: The driver swerved to avoid a deep pothole.
ex.zh: 駕駛人為了閃避深坑而突然轉向。

ex.en: Residents reported several potholes after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，居民通報了好幾個路面坑洞。

pothole.en: a hole in the surface of a road

ex.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方抵達了事故現場。

ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查事故原因。

ex.en: The fire station is next to the police station.
ex.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁邊。

police.en: the people whose job is to catch criminals and keep order

ex.en: Tom probably knows why the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 湯姆大概知道會議延期的原因。

ex.en: Their trip was postponed because of the rain.
ex.zh: 他們的旅行因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: Bob suggested postponing the party till Wednesday.
ex.zh: 鮑伯建議將聚會延後到週三。

postpone.en: to decide that something will happen at a later time

ex.en: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
ex.zh: 他指出了遵守法律的重要性。

ex.en: The teacher pointed out your mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師指出了你的錯誤。

ex.en: Excuse me; allow me to point out three errors in the above article.
ex.zh: 抱歉，請允許我指出上文中的三個錯誤。

point out.en: to tell someone about a fact or make them notice it

ex.en: Do you think he is good for the position?
ex.zh: 你認為他適合這個職位嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這份職位要求應徵者有一定的英語口語表達能力。

ex.en: Many people get a job in customer services before they are qualified for other positions.
ex.zh: 許多人在有資格擔任其他職位之前，會先從客服工作做起。

position.en: a job in a company or organization

ex.en: The soldiers retreated from their positions.
ex.zh: 士兵們撤離了陣地。

ex.en: I'm not in a position to make that decision.
ex.zh: 我沒有立場做這個決定。

position.en: the place where someone or something is, or the situation someone is in

ex.en: Designers usually bring a portfolio to the interview.
ex.zh: 設計師面試時通常會帶作品集。

ex.en: Her online portfolio shows her best photos.
ex.zh: 她的線上作品集展示了她最好的照片。

portfolio.en: a collection of a person's work, such as pictures, shown to possible employers

ex.en: It's wise to have a diverse investment portfolio.
ex.zh: 擁有多元的投資組合是明智的。

ex.en: He reviews his portfolio once a month.
ex.zh: 他每個月檢視一次自己的投資組合。

portfolio.en: a collection of money put into different businesses to make a profit

ex.en: We sat on the porch and watched the rain.
ex.zh: 我們坐在門廊上看雨。

ex.en: He left the package on the front porch.
ex.zh: 他把包裹放在前門的門廊上。

ex.en: The porch light was on all night.
ex.zh: 門廊的燈整晚都亮著。

ex.en: Ducks were swimming in the pond near our house.
ex.zh: 鴨子在我們家附近的池塘裡游泳。

ex.en: The children caught tadpoles in the pond.
ex.zh: 孩子們在池塘裡抓蝌蚪。

ex.en: The pope visited several countries last year.
ex.zh: 教宗去年訪問了好幾個國家。

ex.en: Crowds gathered in the square to see the pope.
ex.zh: 群眾聚集在廣場上想看教宗一眼。

ex.en: We had roasted pork with rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤豬肉配飯。

ex.en: This restaurant is famous for its pork dumplings.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以豬肉水餃聞名。

ex.en: Don't poke the dog with a stick.
ex.zh: 不要用棍子戳那隻狗。

ex.en: She poked me in the arm to wake me up.
ex.zh: 她戳了我的手臂叫醒我。

ex.en: He poked his head out of the window.
ex.zh: 他把頭從窗戶探出去。

ex.en: Green shoots poked through the soil.
ex.zh: 綠色嫩芽從土裡冒出來。

ex.en: She gave him a poke in the ribs.
ex.zh: 她用手指戳了他的肋骨一下。

ex.en: A gentle poke woke the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 輕輕一戳就把睡著的貓弄醒了。

ex.en: Poland is a country in central Europe.
ex.zh: 波蘭是中歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Warsaw is the capital of Poland.
ex.zh: 華沙是波蘭的首都。

ex.en: He studied engineering at a polytechnic before getting a job.
ex.zh: 他在找工作之前，先在理工專科學校讀工程。

ex.en: The polytechnic offers practical courses in design and technology.

ex.en: She pointedly looked at her watch when he arrived late.
ex.zh: 他遲到時，她刻意看了看手錶。

ex.en: He pointedly ignored the rude comment.
ex.zh: 他刻意不理會那句無禮的話。

ex.en: Many people worry about the growing polarization of society.
ex.zh: 許多人擔心社會日益兩極分化。

ex.en: Polarization of light is used in some types of sunglasses.
ex.zh: 部分太陽眼鏡運用了光的偏振原理。

ex.en: This shirt is made of polyester and dries quickly.
ex.zh: 這件襯衫是聚酯纖維做的，乾得很快。

ex.en: Polyester is cheaper than silk but less breathable.
ex.zh: 聚酯纖維比絲便宜，但透氣性較差。

postcolonial.zh: 後殖民的、殖民時期之後的

ex.en: She teaches a class on postcolonial literature.
ex.zh: 她教一門後殖民文學的課。

ex.en: Many postcolonial countries are still building their institutions.
ex.zh: 許多後殖民時代的國家仍在建立自己的制度。

ex.en: Some people try to politicize every news story.
ex.zh: 有些人想把每則新聞都政治化。

ex.en: Let's not politicize this tragedy.
ex.zh: 我們不要把這場悲劇政治化。

ex.en: The show helped popularize cooking at home.
ex.zh: 這個節目使在家做菜變得更普及。

ex.en: Scientists try to popularize new ideas with simple language.
ex.zh: 科學家試著用簡單的語言讓新觀念普及。

ex.en: Postmodernism changed the way people think about art and architecture.
ex.zh: 後現代主義改變了人們看待藝術和建築的方式。

ex.en: We read about postmodernism in my literature class.
ex.zh: 我們在文學課上讀到了後現代主義。

ex.en: The doctor removed a small polyp from his throat.
ex.zh: 醫生從他的喉嚨裡切除了一顆小息肉。

ex.en: A polyp is usually harmless, but it should be checked.
ex.zh: 息肉通常無害，但還是應該檢查。

ex.en: Sponges are soft and porous.
ex.zh: 海綿又軟又多孔。

ex.en: Water slowly passes through the porous rock.
ex.zh: 水慢慢地穿過多孔的岩石。

populous.zh: 人口眾多的；人口稠密的

ex.en: Indonesia is one of the most populous countries in the world.
ex.zh: 印尼是世界上人口最多的國家之一。

ex.en: The populous coastal region is crowded with traffic every morning.
ex.zh: 這個人口稠密的沿海地區每天早上都塞滿了車。

ex.en: The river was too polluted for anyone to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河汙染得太嚴重，沒人能下去游泳。

ex.en: People living in polluted cities often suffer from breathing problems.
ex.zh: 住在空氣汙濁城市的人常有呼吸方面的問題。

ex.en: We must protect these forests for the sake of posterity.
ex.zh: 為了子孫後代，我們必須保護這些森林。

ex.en: The old letters were kept for posterity in a museum.
ex.zh: 這些舊信件被保存在博物館裡留給後世。

ex.en: The posterior part of the skull protects the back of the brain.
ex.zh: 頭骨後部保護著大腦的後側。

ex.en: The doctor examined the posterior wall of the throat.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了喉嚨的後壁。

ex.en: He fell and hurt his posterior on the ice.
ex.zh: 他在冰上跌倒，摔傷了屁股。

ex.en: The toddler sat down hard on his posterior.
ex.zh: 那個小朋友屁股重重地坐到地上。

ex.en: The factory was named as the biggest polluter in the area.
ex.zh: 那間工廠被點名為當地最大的汙染源。

ex.en: Polluters should pay for cleaning up the river.
ex.zh: 汙染者應該負擔清理河川的費用。

ex.en: This small boat is powered by a quiet electric motor.
ex.zh: 這艘小船由安靜的電動馬達驅動。

ex.en: The toy is powered by two batteries.
ex.zh: 這個玩具用兩顆電池供電。

ex.en: The poisoned fish made several people sick.
ex.zh: 那些有毒的魚讓好幾個人生病。

ex.en: Rescuers took the poisoned child to the hospital.
ex.zh: 救援人員把中毒的孩子送到醫院。

polishing.zh: 擦亮；拋光（polish 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is polishing his shoes before the interview.
ex.zh: 他正在面試前擦亮他的皮鞋。

ex.en: She spent the morning polishing the silver spoons.
ex.zh: 她花了一上午擦亮那些銀湯匙。

ex.en: I'm polishing my speech before the big day.
ex.zh: 我正在大日子來臨前潤飾我的演講稿。

ex.en: He is polishing his English by reading every day.
ex.zh: 他每天閱讀來精進自己的英文。

ex.en: Tall poplar trees line both sides of the road.
ex.zh: 高大的楊樹排列在道路兩旁。

ex.en: The wind made the leaves of the poplar shake gently.
ex.zh: 風讓楊樹的葉子輕輕搖動。

ex.en: She placed a potted plant by the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗邊放了一盆盆栽。

ex.en: The balcony was full of potted herbs and flowers.
ex.zh: 陽台擺滿了盆栽的香草與花朵。

ex.en: We had potted meat sandwiches for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們午餐吃了罐裝肉醬三明治。

ex.en: Potted shrimp is a traditional English dish.
ex.zh: 罐裝醃蝦是一道傳統的英國菜。

ex.en: He is very possessive of his toys and won't share.
ex.zh: 他對自己的玩具佔有慾很強，不肯分享。

ex.en: A possessive friend may get upset when you spend time with others.
ex.zh: 佔有慾強的朋友可能會因為你和別人相處而不高興。

ex.en: "Mine" and "hers" are possessives.
ex.zh: 「mine」和「hers」是所有格。

ex.en: The teacher explained how to form the possessive of a noun.
ex.zh: 老師講解了如何構成名詞的所有格。

ex.en: The dish is popularly known as stinky tofu.
ex.zh: 這道菜俗稱臭豆腐。

ex.en: Tea is popularly believed to help you relax.
ex.zh: 大家普遍認為喝茶有助於放鬆。

ex.en: The suspect agreed to take a polygraph test.
ex.zh: 嫌疑人同意接受測謊。

ex.en: A polygraph measures things like heart rate and breathing.
ex.zh: 測謊機會測量心跳和呼吸等數據。

ex.en: Rangers caught a poacher in the national park.
ex.zh: 護林員在國家公園裡抓到一名偷獵者。

ex.en: Poachers kill elephants for their tusks.
ex.zh: 偷獵者為了象牙而獵殺大象。

ex.en: Our neighbor has a small white poodle.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居養了一隻小小的白色貴賓狗。

ex.en: The poodle jumped up and ran to greet its owner.
ex.zh: 那隻貴賓狗跳起來，跑去迎接牠的主人。

ex.en: The witch in the story stirred a green potion.
ex.zh: 故事裡的女巫攪拌著一鍋綠色的魔藥。

ex.en: He drank the magic potion and fell asleep for a hundred years.
ex.zh: 他喝下魔藥後睡了一百年。

ex.en: We had creamy polenta with mushrooms for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了配蘑菇的綿密玉米糊。

ex.en: Polenta is made by boiling ground corn in water.
ex.zh: 玉米糊是把玉米粉加水煮成的。

ex.en: The fragile vase was packed in polystyrene foam.
ex.zh: 易碎的花瓶用保麗龍泡沫包裝。

ex.en: Polystyrene cups are light but hard to recycle.
ex.zh: 保麗龍杯很輕，但難以回收。

ex.en: She sprinkled pomegranate seeds on the salad.
ex.zh: 她在沙拉上撒了石榴籽。

ex.en: A ripe pomegranate is red and full of juicy seeds.
ex.zh: 熟透的石榴是紅色的，裡面滿是多汁的籽。

ex.en: The little girl pouted when she couldn't have candy.
ex.zh: 小女孩不能吃糖時就噘起了嘴。

ex.en: Don't pout; we can play again tomorrow.
ex.zh: 別噘嘴了，我們明天可以再玩。

ex.en: She gave a pout and crossed her arms.
ex.zh: 她噘著嘴，雙手抱在胸前。

ex.en: With a sulky pout, he refused to answer.
ex.zh: 他噘著嘴賭氣，不肯回答。

ex.en: The professor teaches a course on the poetics of modern literature.
ex.zh: 教授開了一門現代文學詩學的課。

ex.en: Aristotle wrote an early work called Poetics.
ex.zh: 亞里斯多德寫過一本早期著作，名叫《詩學》。

ex.en: The young player has great potentiality.
ex.zh: 這位年輕球員很有潛力。

ex.en: We should explore the potentiality of solar energy.
ex.zh: 我們應該探索太陽能的潛在可能。

ex.en: The magnet's polarity decides which way it points.
ex.zh: 磁鐵的極性決定它指向哪個方向。

ex.en: There is a strong polarity between the two groups' views.
ex.zh: 兩個團體的看法截然對立。

ex.en: The policewoman helped the lost child find his mother.
ex.zh: 那位女警幫迷路的孩子找到了媽媽。

ex.en: A policewoman stopped traffic at the crossing.
ex.zh: 一位女警在路口指揮交通。

ex.en: He thanked everyone with great politeness.
ex.zh: 他非常有禮貌地向大家道謝。

ex.en: Politeness costs nothing but means a lot.
ex.zh: 禮貌不花一毛錢，卻意義重大。

ex.en: A posse of reporters waited outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 一群記者守在飯店外面。

ex.en: In old western movies, the sheriff gathers a posse to chase the thief.
ex.zh: 在老西部電影裡，警長會召集一隊人去追小偷。

ex.en: We waited under the portico until the rain stopped.
ex.zh: 我們在門廊下等到雨停。

ex.en: The old library has a stone portico with tall columns.
ex.zh: 那座老圖書館有一個帶高大柱子的石造門廊。

ex.en: She joined a support group for postpartum mothers.
ex.zh: 她加入了產後媽媽的支持團體。

ex.en: Doctors recommend a postpartum checkup a few weeks after birth.
ex.zh: 醫生建議在生產後幾週做產後檢查。

ex.en: The toddler is learning to use the potty.
ex.zh: 這個幼兒正在學習使用便盆。

ex.en: She put a small potty in the bathroom for her son.
ex.zh: 她在浴室為兒子放了一個小便盆。

ex.en: My uncle is a bit potty about his garden gnomes.
ex.zh: 我叔叔對他的花園小矮人有點著迷到癡狂。

ex.en: You must be potty to go swimming in this cold weather!
ex.zh: 這種冷天還去游泳，你一定是瘋了！

ex.en: She is famous for her portraiture in oil.
ex.zh: 她以油畫肖像畫聞名。

ex.en: The gallery has a room devoted to portraiture.
ex.zh: 這間美術館有一個專門展示肖像畫的展廳。

ex.en: The book explains the rise of populism in many countries.
ex.zh: 這本書解釋了民粹主義在許多國家的興起。

ex.en: Some experts worry that populism can divide society.
ex.zh: 有些專家擔心民粹主義會造成社會分裂。

ex.en: Many people dislike the politicization of sports.
ex.zh: 許多人不喜歡運動被政治化。

ex.en: The politicization of the issue made a calm discussion hard.
ex.zh: 這個議題被政治化，讓人很難冷靜討論。

ex.en: Porto is a city in northern Portugal.
ex.zh: 波多是葡萄牙北部的一座城市。

ex.en: Porto is famous for its wine and old bridges.
ex.zh: 波多以葡萄酒和古老的橋聞名。

ex.en: Positivism holds that real knowledge comes from observation and experiment.
ex.zh: 實證主義認為真正的知識來自觀察與實驗。

ex.en: The professor gave a lecture on positivism in science.
ex.zh: 教授做了一場關於科學中實證主義的演講。

ex.en: Many shopping bags are made of polyethylene.
ex.zh: 許多購物袋是用聚乙烯做的。

ex.en: Polyethylene is a common type of plastic.
ex.zh: 聚乙烯是一種常見的塑膠。

ex.en: His article was a fierce polemic against the new tax.
ex.zh: 他的文章是一篇反對新稅制的激烈辯駁。

ex.en: The book is less a study than a polemic about education.
ex.zh: 這本書與其說是研究，不如說是一篇關於教育的論戰。

ex.en: A porpoise is smaller than a dolphin and has a blunt nose.
ex.zh: 鼠海豚比海豚小，鼻子也比較圓鈍。

ex.en: We saw a porpoise jump out of the water near the boat.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻鼠海豚在船邊躍出水面。

ex.en: A positivist believes knowledge should come from observation.
ex.zh: 實證主義者認為知識應來自觀察。

ex.en: The professor was a positivist who trusted experiments over opinions.
ex.zh: 那位教授是實證主義者，相信實驗勝過意見。

ex.en: A triangle is the simplest polygon.
ex.zh: 三角形是最簡單的多邊形。

ex.en: Draw a polygon with six equal sides.
ex.zh: 畫一個有六條相等邊的多邊形。

ex.en: The software lets you draw a polygon around the area you want to select.
ex.zh: 這個軟體讓你在想選取的範圍周圍畫出多邊形。

ex.en: The porosity of the soil affects how fast water drains.
ex.zh: 土壤的孔隙度會影響排水的速度。

ex.en: Sponges have high porosity, so they absorb a lot of liquid.
ex.zh: 海綿的多孔性很高，所以能吸收大量液體。

ex.en: They danced a lively polka at the wedding.
ex.zh: 他們在婚禮上跳了一支活潑的波爾卡舞。

ex.en: The band played a polka, and everyone clapped along.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了一首波爾卡舞曲，大家跟著拍手。

politicized.zh: 使政治化（politicize 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The issue has become highly politicized in recent years.
ex.zh: 這個議題近年來已被高度政治化。

ex.en: Many teachers dislike having a politicized classroom.
ex.zh: 許多老師不喜歡課堂被政治化。

ex.en: A polypeptide is a chain of amino acids.
ex.zh: 多肽是由胺基酸連成的長鏈。

ex.en: The body makes this polypeptide in the pancreas.
ex.zh: 身體在胰臟中製造這種多肽。

ex.en: Chicken pox causes an itchy rash and a mild fever.
ex.zh: 水痘會引起發癢的疹子和輕微發燒。

ex.en: Smallpox was once a deadly pox that spread around the world.
ex.zh: 天花曾是一種散布全世界的致命痘病。

ex.en: The author is known as a postmodernist.
ex.zh: 這位作家被視為後現代主義者。

ex.en: Many postmodernists question traditional ideas of truth.
ex.zh: 許多後現代主義者質疑傳統的真理觀。

ex.en: Dark clouds portend a coming storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。

ex.en: The sudden drop in sales may portend trouble.
ex.zh: 銷售量驟降可能預示著麻煩。

ex.en: The witch wore a tall pointy hat.
ex.zh: 那個女巫戴著一頂高高的尖帽子。

ex.en: Be careful with that pointy stick.
ex.zh: 小心那根尖尖的棍子。

ex.en: He felt a deep sense of powerlessness during the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水來襲時，他深深感到無能為力。

ex.en: Powerlessness can make people give up trying.
ex.zh: 無力感可能讓人放棄努力。

ex.en: The skiers loved the light, powdery snow.
ex.zh: 滑雪的人喜歡這種輕盈蓬鬆的粉雪。

ex.en: The cake was covered with a powdery layer of sugar.
ex.zh: 蛋糕上撒了一層粉狀的糖。

ex.en: The wedding was held with great pomp.
ex.zh: 婚禮辦得非常盛大隆重。

ex.en: The new king arrived amid pomp and ceremony.
ex.zh: 新國王在隆重的儀式中抵達。

ex.en: Polygamy is illegal in many countries.
ex.zh: 多配偶制在許多國家是違法的。

ex.en: The book discusses the history of polygamy in some cultures.
ex.zh: 這本書討論某些文化中多配偶制的歷史。

ex.en: The possessor of the ticket will be allowed into the hall.
ex.zh: 持有這張票的人可以進入大廳。

ex.en: She was proud to be the possessor of such a rare book.
ex.zh: 她很自豪能成為這本稀有書籍的擁有者。

polarized.zh: 使兩極化（polarize 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The debate polarized the town into two opposing groups.
ex.zh: 這場辯論使全鎮分裂成兩個對立的陣營。

ex.en: Opinion on the new law has polarized people across the country.
ex.zh: 對這項新法律的看法讓全國民意兩極化。

ex.en: The writer received a posthumous award for her last book.
ex.zh: 這位作家因她的最後一本書獲得了追贈的獎項。

ex.en: His posthumous fame was greater than anything he knew in life.
ex.zh: 他死後的名聲遠超過他生前所知的一切。

ex.en: She wore a bright yellow poncho to stay dry in the rain.
ex.zh: 她穿著鮮黃色的雨披在雨中保持乾燥。

ex.en: He bought a woolen poncho at the market in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他在山區的市集買了一件羊毛披風。

ex.en: She got a postdoctoral position at a university abroad.
ex.zh: 她在國外一所大學獲得博士後職位。

ex.en: He is doing postdoctoral research in chemistry.
ex.zh: 他正在做化學方面的博士後研究。

ex.en: She looked out of the porthole at the open sea.
ex.zh: 她從舷窗望向遼闊的海面。

ex.en: Sunlight came through the small round porthole.
ex.zh: 陽光從小小的圓形舷窗照進來。

ex.en: The elephant moved with slow, ponderous steps.
ex.zh: 大象邁著緩慢而沉重的步伐。

ex.en: His ponderous speech put the audience to sleep.
ex.zh: 他冗長乏味的演講讓聽眾昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: A possum was digging through the trash can last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚有隻負鼠在翻垃圾桶。

ex.en: When scared, a possum may pretend to be dead.
ex.zh: 負鼠受到驚嚇時可能會裝死。

ex.en: Tokyo is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.
ex.zh: 東京是世界上人口最稠密的城市之一。

ex.en: The island is sparsely populated, with only a few farms.
ex.zh: 這座島人口稀少，只有幾座農場。

ex.en: The politico spent years in city hall.
ex.zh: 那位政客在市政廳待了好幾年。

ex.en: Seasoned politicos know how to work a room.
ex.zh: 經驗老到的政客知道怎麼周旋於人群之間。

ex.en: A porcupine raises its sharp quills when it feels threatened.
ex.zh: 豪豬感到受威脅時會豎起尖刺。

ex.en: We saw a porcupine crossing the trail at dusk.
ex.zh: 黃昏時我們看到一隻豪豬穿過小徑。

ex.en: The sofa is filled with polyurethane foam.
ex.zh: 這張沙發裡面填的是聚氨酯泡棉。

ex.en: He painted the table with a coat of polyurethane to protect the wood.
ex.zh: 他在桌子上塗了一層聚氨酯來保護木頭。

posturing.zh: 擺姿態；裝腔作勢（posture 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The politicians kept posturing instead of solving the problem.
ex.zh: 政客們一直在擺姿態，而不是解決問題。

ex.en: The two boys were posturing in front of the girls.
ex.zh: 兩個男孩在女孩們面前擺架子。

ex.en: The team held a quick powwow before the big match.
ex.zh: 大賽前，球隊開了個簡短的討論會。

ex.en: Let's have a powwow after lunch to plan the trip.
ex.zh: 午餐後我們開個會討論這趟旅行。

ex.en: The managers powwowed in the hall for an hour.
ex.zh: 經理們在大廳商談了一個小時。

ex.en: Let's powwow later and decide what to do.
ex.zh: 我們晚點討論一下再決定怎麼做。

ex.en: Bees are the most important pollinators of many crops.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂是許多農作物最重要的授粉者。

ex.en: Planting flowers helps attract pollinators to your garden.
ex.zh: 種花有助於吸引授粉昆蟲來到花園。

ex.en: A portly gentleman in a gray suit sat by the window.
ex.zh: 一位身穿灰色西裝、身形發福的紳士坐在窗邊。

ex.en: The portly chef tasted the soup and nodded.
ex.zh: 矮胖的主廚嚐了嚐湯，點了點頭。

ex.en: The laptop's portability makes it great for travel.
ex.zh: 這台筆電的可攜性很適合旅行。

ex.en: Buyers like the portability of small speakers.
ex.zh: 買家喜歡小型喇叭的輕便好攜帶。

ex.en: The book helped popularise yoga in many countries.
ex.zh: 這本書幫助瑜伽在許多國家普及起來。

ex.en: They hope to popularise cycling by building more bike lanes.
ex.zh: 他們希望透過興建更多自行車道來推廣騎車。

potluck.zh: 百樂餐（每人各帶一道菜的聚餐）

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to the office potluck.
ex.zh: 每個人都帶了一道菜來參加辦公室的百樂餐。

ex.en: We are having a potluck in the park on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們星期六要在公園辦百樂餐。

ex.en: The dog left poop on the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 那隻狗在人行道上留下了大便。

ex.en: Please pick up your dog's poop in the park.
ex.zh: 請在公園裡清理你家狗狗的便便。

ex.en: The puppy pooped on the carpet again.
ex.zh: 小狗又在地毯上大便了。

ex.en: Babies poop many times a day.
ex.zh: 嬰兒一天會大便好幾次。

ex.en: Dark clouds were a portent of the coming storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲是暴風雨將至的徵兆。

ex.en: Some people saw the strange event as a portent of bad luck.
ex.zh: 有些人把那件怪事視為厄運的預兆。

ex.en: The author's last novel was published posthumously.
ex.zh: 那位作者的最後一部小說在他死後出版。

ex.en: She was posthumously awarded a medal for bravery.
ex.zh: 她在身後被追贈了一枚勇氣勳章。

ex.en: We relaxed at the poolside all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊放鬆。

ex.en: The hotel serves drinks at the poolside.
ex.zh: 飯店在泳池邊提供飲料。

ex.en: They had a poolside lunch under the umbrella.
ex.zh: 他們在傘下享用泳池邊的午餐。

ex.en: The poolside bar opens at noon.
ex.zh: 泳池邊的酒吧中午開門。

ex.en: The tap water here is potable.
ex.zh: 這裡的自來水可以飲用。

ex.en: The camp has no potable water, so bring your own.
ex.zh: 營地沒有飲用水，所以要自己帶。

ex.en: She pointed to the map and said, "We are here."
ex.zh: 她指著地圖說：「我們在這裡。」

ex.en: The boy pointed to the cake on the table.
ex.zh: 男孩指向桌上的蛋糕。

ex.en: All the signs point to a better year ahead.
ex.zh: 所有跡象都顯示接下來會是更好的一年。

point to.en: to show something by pointing with your finger
